title: AI OSS tool repo goes archived over night after raising $7.3M Seed
brief: An open-source AI tool repository was unexpectedly archived overnight following a $7.3M seed funding round, raising questions about the company's direction and commitment to the open-source community. The sudden move sparked significant discussion on Hacker News with 251 upvotes and 162 comments, suggesting it touched a nerve about transparency and trust in AI OSS projects.
